svg.title: Boggle Basketwood — Basketmakers’ canopy
svg.desc: Woven basket platforms hang between old orchard trunks. The craft hut and dropped fruit crates form cover, with an upper collection loop over the Boggle pocket. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: Woven basket platforms hang between old orchard trunks. The craft hut and dropped fruit
crates form cover, with an upper collection loop over the Boggle pocket.
7 raised landings · 2 stair flights · 3 rope climbs · 2 ladders · 20 placed props
R = same-map recovery · structural concept, not an exported collision mesh
Encounter: Orchard Boggle · Hostile / Common; optional local encounter.
